claim_limits: Finite-grid retrospective diagnostic only, with all coupled ODE trajectories already present.
No solver replacement, hidden fitting, new completed scientific trajectories, measured speedup, decoupling theorem, or prospective accuracy bound.
Full scalar norms are not added; the additive diagnostic applies to signed observables.

findings.resolution: V1 numerical outputs preserved. V2 explicitly labels finite-precision 80-digit arithmetic; no scientific solver or raw trajectory changed.

independent_fraction_vs_80digit_interact.interpretation: The 80-digit Decimal channel has finite-precision residuals below 1e-98 at 12 exact rational zeros. The v2 source and summary now explicitly label high precision rather than exact arithmetic.

interpretation.relative_error_caveat: The total-stress pointwise relative maximum exceeds 5 near small actual stress. Do not replace this with a uniform small relative-error or cancellation-accuracy claim.
interpretation.shear_scale_caveat: The total shear-support scale includes initial |S0|=.012; use the separately recorded response-increment scale when discussing response accuracy.

reviewer: independent theory_literature agent, not diagnostic implementer
